reconcile.note: Gill reads Rachel's theft of her father's household gods as a credit to her character, an anti-idolatry act rather than a violation of the eighth commandment.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Wells presses the same episode as evidence that the Bible's own narrative undercuts the absolute wording of the eighth commandment.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father's.
sides.verseText: Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep: and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father's.
